Name: Simple Meat Plants (AHM meat)
Author: Raellen
Description:
[size=3]Love the [b]Animal Husbandry Mod[/b] but too soft-hearted to butcher your animals?
[b]Simple Meat Plants[/b] offers a peaceful alternative: grow your meat resources like crops and keep your beloved animals safe on the farm.



[size=5][b]How to use:
[/b][/size][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]All meat seeds can be purchased at Pierre's Store.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Once fully grown, meat plants will continue to regrow, providing a steady supply of meat throughout their active seasons.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][b]Note:[/b] You must unlock the [b]Ostrich Incubator[/b] recipe before [b]Ostrich Seeds[/b] will appear in the shop.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Growth Seasons & Shop Availability[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Beef Seeds[/b] : Spring, Summer[/*]
[*][b]Chicken Seeds[/b] : Spring, Summer[/*]
[*][b]Rabbit Seeds[/b] : Spring, Summer[/*]
[*][b]Mutton Seeds[/b] : Spring, Summer and Fall[/*]
[*][b]Pork Seeds[/b] : Summer, Fall[/*]
[*][b]Duck Seeds[/b] : Summer, Fall[/*]
[*][b]Ostrich Seeds[/b] : Summer, Fall (Requires Ostrich Incubator recipe to unlock ostrich seeds)[/*]
[/list][b]Note:[/b] Pierre does not sell any of the seeds during [b]Winter[/b].
